name: Chicken Celebrity
description: A sweet and savory chicken dish with a ketchup-based sauce, perfect for baking.

recipeInstructions.text: Arrange chicken parts in a small roaster or casserole.
Mix the rest of the ingredients together. Spoon over chicken, covering all pieces.
Bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour or until tender.

keywords: baked chicken, sweet and savory, ketchup-based sauce

_similar.name: Sweet & Sour Pineapple Chicken
_similar.description: A sweet and tangy chicken dish baked in a pineapple-based sauce, perfect for a comforting meal.
recipeIngredient: ⅗ cup (¼ cup + 2 Tbsp) crushed pineapple, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Simmer the chicken breasts in water until cooked through, turning occasionally.
In a pan, combine crushed pineapple, vinegar, brown sugar, salt, ketchup, and water. Cook over heat, stirring until the sauce thickens.
Place the cooked chicken in a casserole dish and pour the sweet and sour sauce over the top.
Cover the dish with tinfoil and bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, pineapple chicken, baked chicken

_similar.name: Sweet and Sour Chicken
_similar.description: A simple and flavorful sweet and sour chicken recipe using onion soup mix and apricot jam.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together onion soup mix, apricot jam, and Russian dressing in a bowl.
Pour the mixture over the chicken in a baking dish.
Bake at 350°F for 2 hours.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, easy chicken recipe, apricot jam chicken

_similar.name: Lemon Chicken With Thyme
_similar.description: A flavorful chicken dish made with lemon juice, thyme, and a light flour coating, served with lemon wedges and parsley.
recipeIngredient: Lemon halves and chopped parsley for garnish (optional)

recipeInstructions.text: In a plastic bag, combine flour, salt, and pepper. Add chicken and shake to coat lightly.
In a large skillet, warm oil over medium heat. Brown chicken about 5 minutes each side. Transfer to a plate.
Coarsely chop the onion. Add margarine to the skillet and stir until softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in reserved flour and combine. Add chicken broth, lemon juice, and thyme. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Return chicken to skillet, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover. Cook until chicken is tender, about 5 minutes.
Serve with lemon wedges and a sprinkling of parsley, if desired.

_similar.name: Sour 'N Sweet Pork Chops
_similar.description: A tangy and sweet pork chop dish simmered in a rich sauce made with brown sugar, vinegar, and Worcestershire sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Drain excess fat from pork chops and brown them in a large frying pan.
Mix together water, brown sugar, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, and ketchup. Pour over the browned chops.
Simmer for 30 minutes or until done.
If desired, thicken the liquid with 2 Tbsp flour. Serve with rice.

_similar.keywords: sour sweet pork chops, tangy pork, brown sugar sauce

_similar.name: Sliced Ham
_similar.description: A simple baked ham recipe with a brown sugar, mustard, and allspice topping.
recipeIngredient: 6 slices ham, about ½ inch thick

recipeInstructions.text: Place ham slices on a cookie sheet.
Mix brown sugar, dry mustard, and allspice together. Sprinkle over ham slices.
Bake in 350°F oven for 20 to 30 minutes, turning once and sprinkling additional mixture on the other side.

_similar.keywords: baked ham, glazed ham, sweet ham
